paper.title: OS-Copilot: Towards Generalist Computer Agents with Self-Improvement
paper.central_claim: OS-Copilot构建通用OS代理FRIDAY，经自我批评修复及自定课程积累工具，在GAIA比前法高35%并泛化未见应用，以极少监督学会Excel/PowerPoint。

provenance.notes: 按现有派发model type sonnet → gpt-6.1-sol；无可独立保存的实际路由回执/会话ID，不探测。

sections_read: 全文§1–6及Appendix A–G，全部提示/工具清单、表1–14及局限；HTML Table13仅示例代码标题无代码体，不还原

evidence.quote: In the current implementation, tools scoring above 8 are preserved by updating the tool repository in procedural memory
evidence.support_explanation: 成功后LLM通用性评分>8入库，非独立多输入测试。

evidence.quote: The FRIDAY will iterate through steps ④ to ⑥ until the subtask is considered completed or a maximum of three attempts is reached.
evidence.support_explanation: 执行批评修复最多三次。

evidence.quote: FRIDAY then follows this curriculum, resolving these tasks through trial and error, thereby accumulating valuable tools and semantic knowledge throughout the process.
evidence.support_explanation: 实践产生持久工具/知识，非权重更新。

evidence.quote: We initialize FRIDAY with four basic tools and facilitate its exploration of the dev set of GAIA to accumulate more tools (result in 9 more tools).
evidence.support_explanation: dev四基础工具加九新工具再测试。

evidence.quote: Due to the limited budget, we use GPT4-turbo-1106 in FRIDAY.

evidence.support_explanation: 学习增量4.30/2.52/0百分点，35%不是留存单因果。

evidence.quote: All results are reported on the private test set, except for the Human score, which is averaged across the dev and test sets.
FRIDAY then solves these 10 tasks and autonomously accumulates 8 tools, including operations such as counting elements and deleting sheets by name
FRIDAY, without self-directed learning, is unable to complete any tasks
evidence.support_explanation: 无学习失败，倾向错误包。

evidence.quote: evaluating subtask completion entails comparing two system states using hard-coded rules or LLMs, presenting scalability challenges and can be potentially inaccurate.
evidence.support_explanation: 内部成功验证可能错误，未审计。

evidence.quote: Our annotations results, however, slightly differ from those returned by the evaluation server.
evidence.support_explanation: 人工核与服务器略不同。
在线均时；不含离线构造总成本，正文105s与表118s冲突。

evidence.quote: Notably, the FRIDAY currently only supports retrieving information from a website and can not perform actions within the web, such as clicks.
the goals of the specific task can not be hard-coded into the method.
evidence.support_explanation: 参数化而非硬编码目标。

evidence.quote: no suitable tools are identified (similarities below a specified threshold), prompting activation of the Tool Generator
evidence.support_explanation: 检索缺口触发工具生成；未给具体阈值。

evidence.quote: we gather comprehensive system information before and after execution and employ LLMs to automatically evaluate the completion state.
This dataset includes 20 spreadsheet control tasks, covering various operations such as Formatting, Management, Charts, Pivot Tables, and Formulas

evidence.support_explanation: 单次Pass@1 12/20 vs0；历史SheetCopilot55%只有一题差。

evidence.quote: the code’s generality is scored by assigning an integer score between 1 and 10
evidence.support_explanation: 通用性分数依赖静态分析，不是新参数执行验证。
